top_signals.title: Kuwait Is Pumping Oil at About 75% of Prewar Rate, KPC CEO Says
top_signals.summary: Kuwait is pumping oil at about 75% of the level it was at before the Iran war started as more tankers take the risk of navigating the Strait of Hormuz, the chief executive officer of the nation’s state oil company said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Saudi IPO Proposals Face Bank Pushback Over Unsold Share Risk
top_signals.summary: Bankers are pushing back against the Saudi regulator’s proposed overhaul of listing rules, including plans that would force underwriters to buy any unsold shares, and warned that the moves could further dampen the market for initial public offerings.
